A stack is a data structure where the last element added is the first one to be removed. This is known as Last In, First Out (LIFO).  
FIFO (First In, First Out) refers to a queue, not a stack.  
Flash memory is a type of storage, not related to the stack data structure.  
LILO is not a standard term for stack; it is sometimes used interchangeably with FIFO.
